scope: Equivalent portable production capability; no individual product, credentials or model weights backed up

referenceEnvironment.note: Reference profile, not a claim that every OS/GPU produces identical pixels. Accept a new machine only after doctor + neutral smoke + a pilot shot for the intended project.

originalFrameBaseline.thresholdSource: Existing video production comparison profile, fixed before extraction: meanRGB<3, fractionAbove30<.02; not changed to make test pass
originalFrameBaseline.notes: Original renderer itself varied in one label on repeated capture. Explicit Vietnamese font barrier stabilizes measurement. Residual PNG image raster differences remain, so no pixel-identical/cross-GPU promise. Original app/product sources unchanged.

checks.environment: Host permission context; managed-sandbox attempt hit temporary-file EPERM, not assertion failures.

checks.scope: Both original repo and clean exported source, own fresh Python venv.

checks.command: scoped eslint + prettier checks for new JS/TS/config/docs
TypeScript tsc on initialized starter with explicit pinned-runtime module paths
pnpm video align --audio <authorized local 5-second clip> --script <approved local script> --cache-dir <existing model cache> --output <local JSON>
pnpm video package --project <verified neutral starter> --render-dir <verified render> --output <new ZIP>

cleanSourceTest.method: git archive of source commit, apply committed asset-byte correction, install dependencies into the exported tree; no copied node_modules, venv, .local, private product assets or keys

smoke.scope: Neutral fixture: common map/islands/font/image identity/karaoke/actions, full MP4 decoded references and audio. No paid calls, no real speech or creative-content approval. Not a cross-GPU pixel identity guarantee.

hyperframes.scope: Actual published HyperFrames check + two rendered paused-GSAP frames. Vox adapter presence/identity is covered by doctor; no live AI planning, generated media, external vision or paid call.

cleanSourceTest.firstAttemptFailure: Three source/license files were initially normalized by Git and failed checksum checks. Fixed with -text attributes and git add --renormalize; no thresholds relaxed.

limits: Clean export tested on the same Windows host, not a different physical machine or Linux/macOS.
Original frame baseline is not strictly pixel-identical in two of six frames; unchanged production thresholds pass. Mixer baseline is byte-identical for all four WAV files.
Smoke fixture proves technical plumbing, not the creative quality or factual correctness of future projects.
AI planning/TTS/live catalogue and paid services were not called. Login, API keys and optional public ASR model must be provisioned separately.
Do not expect AI generation or raster output across GPU/OS environments to be 100 percent byte-identical.
